findings.title: Registered metric-alert handler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` now inherits `StatefulDetectorHandler` but implements none of its abstract members (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`). `Detector.detector_handler` instantiates the registered handler with `group_type.detector_handler(self)`, so processing any detector whose type is `metric_alert_fire` will raise `TypeError` instead of safely evaluating as the previous concrete no-op handler did. Keep this handler on the non-stateful base until it is implemented, or provide implementations for all required stateful hooks.

findings.title: Stateful detector evaluation documentation advertises the old list contract
findings.body: The `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate` docstring says it returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`, but the method now returns a dictionary keyed by group key. This is the extension point subclasses implement; following the documented contract would cause `process_detectors` to fail when it calls `.values()` on the returned object. Update the docstring to describe the keyed dictionary and its duplicate-key behavior.
